deadline.intake: Autumn 2027, applicants with non-Swiss certificates (application window 1 Dec - 31 Mar)

tuition.note: CHF 2,190 per semester (threefold fee for foreign students from autumn 2025), x2

requirement.text: Admission depends on country and certificate (swissuniversities/ETH country list); some applicants must pass the ETH entrance examination. German proof is required by 31 March as teaching is in German.
